Overview

Fleet is a Webflow template designed for logistics companies and businesses. It provides a solid foundation for your website with a focus on flexibility and ease of use.

Design & Layout


  • Fluid typography that adjusts to different screen sizes
  • A 12-column grid system for custom layouts
  • Site variables for easy branding and design customization

Interactions & Animations


  • Smooth animations that bring your content to life
  • Custom components that can be reused throughout your project

Key Features


  • Customizable design that adapts to your needs
  • Easy-to-use interface and navigation
  • Optimized for performance and responsiveness

Fleet is a great starting point for your logistics website, offering a balance of design, flexibility, and functionality.
